sources.title: financial-llm/README.md at main · jia-shan/financial-llm · GitHub
sources.snippet: The project starts from Diamegs/PIT-4B-FT-202212 and compares math-reasoning, finance-reasoning, earnings-call, and RLVR-style variants. We evaluate the models both as language models and as embedding models for an earnings-call portfolio experiment.

sources.title: Scaling Point-in-Time Language Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The fine-tuned PIT-4B model (PIT-4B-FT) outperforms its base counterpart across all size groups. This suggests that fine-tuning might improve robustness and generalization of the extracted signals across the cross-section.
